title: ComputeDocResult
description: Output of `model compute` — the runtime computation over a document INSTANCE: what each computed field becomes, evaluated by the native-safe dm interpreter (the sole runtime eval engine on every target; the envelope's `engine` names it). Read-only — the input --instance is never modified. The INPUT --instance shape is NOT restated here — it is `document-instance.schema.json`, served as the `input` half of `dmtool schema model compute`.

computed.description: one entry per computed field INSTANCE — a repeated computed field yields one per row — in evaluation order

declarations.description: how many distinct computations ran. This is the count that answers 'which computations does this model have'; the array length answers a different question

instances.description: how many field instances they produced (= computed.length). Separate from `declarations` because neither implies the other: 2 computations over 5 rows is 2 and 10, and a summary reporting one number is wrong about the other

field.description: the canonical A12 pointer to the computed cell INSTANCE — `Order/Items[2]/Total`: no leading slash, `[1]` omitted, one repetition per part. Identifies the ROW, so a repeated computed field's entries are distinguishable without relying on list position

declaration.description: the canonical A12 path of the computation's target with no repetition — `Order/Items/Total`. Group by this to fold a repeated computed field's rows back into the one computation that produced them

outcome.description: value (computed a value) | cleared (computed nothing, e.g. an empty operand) | error

value.description: the computed value AS THE TARGET FIELD STORES IT — always a string, and the TARGET's own declaration governs the form: nothing of the operand's spelling or the --instance JSON's type survives into it. NUMBER: plain decimal notation, never exponent; the fraction digits are the natural scale raised to the target's declared `minFractionalDigits` and capped by its `maxFractionalDigits`, with no length cap — a min-2 target computes `3` as "3.00", `1e3` as "1000.00", `4.50` as "4.50", and an EMPTY number operand (which reads as 0) as "0.00". DATE / date-range: the TARGET's declared `format` (and range separator), so a yyyy-MM-dd source computed into a dd.MM.yyyy target reads "01.03.2026". On outcome 'error' this is the ATTEMPTED value, rendered by those same rules and reported although the cell is not stored. Absent when cleared
